title: The Black Prism
author: Brent Weeks
summary: In a world where drafters turn coloured light into solid matter, the Prism who keeps the peace between rival powers learns that he has a son he never knew. A looming war and a hidden threat close in on both of them.
readIf: you like epic fantasy with a distinctive magic system and a powerful ruler who may be hiding a lot.
skipIf: you want a gentle fantasy, as the book includes a lot of war and political betrayal.

pairings.reason: Another fast-moving epic with a very clearly built magic system and a rebellion.
A bigger, slower epic with the same fascination for systems of magic and war.
A sharper, funnier fantasy for readers who enjoy clever schemers.
